correctness.rationale: PASS: Reconstructed the actual two-site bisector and the corner-triangle area T=(a sqrt(p/q)+b sqrt(q/p))^2/2, carefully retaining the p<a and q<b constraints and fixed rectangle bounds. Face-reaching caps have O(t^4) four-dimensional measure, negligible against O(t^2). With A=a sqrt(r), B=b/sqrt(r), r=p/q, c=sqrt(2t), the (a,b,p,q) Jacobian is q and the triangular wedge has one-corner/one-label measure c^4/48=t^2/12. The site-pair-to-(mean,half-difference) determinant is 4 and there are 8 classes, yielding 8/3 after normalization by S^2. The normalized density factors into Dirichlet(2,2,1), lambda density min(lambda,lambda^-3), and uniform j; Dirichlet factorization and ell=log lambda give the four stated independent laws. Fixed-rectangle indicators tend to one almost everywhere under the integrable scaled density, proving L1/TV convergence, not just weak convergence. Finite clipping and Monte Carlo are corroboration only; no uniformity over changing aspect ratios is established.
